paragraphs.text: Replace the courtyard downspouts and the outlet accessories above them. Leaves collect at the outlets in autumn.
There are three outlets, all reachable from the courtyard. The photographed leaf guard on the next building is not part of this quote.
Include a tightly fitting wire ball strainer at each of the three gutter outlets, in the same material as the gutters. List strainers as included; no continuous leaf guard is ordered.
Replace three downspouts complete with elbows, offsets and supports; reconnect at the three existing gutter outlets.
Continuous leaf guards excluded. Clean the courtyard after completion. This schedule states all included outlet accessories and downspout work.
